sheets.subject: A wide open meadow of fresh green grass with clover, buttercups and a few taller seed heads, uneven and alive, no paths
An open heath of purple heather and low grass with patches of pale sand and a few small grey stones, no paths
A sunlit woodland clearing floor: green grass and moss cushions broken by patches of brown leaf litter, small ferns and low herbs, no tree trunks
A small hand-sown field of ripening emmer wheat, slightly irregular rows, a grassy edge along the bottom, no fences
